info.title: graphwing
info.description: Local node catalog for Rewst Graph. Deterministic git/gh/file/units/herdr/stack/port plus allowlisted scripts and tests. rrRun is an optional plugin when rr.json is present. One-job agent loops return 202 + job_id; completion POSTs an artifact receipt to response_webhook_url (action.wait.webhook). Cloud GitHub/Shortcut stay Rewst integrations. PR driver is a Graph of these nodes, not one agentRun. Public server URL is written by named-tunnel setup (cloudflared-meta.json) or GRAPHWING_PUBLIC_URL; catalog default is loopback.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path. Default riftwing.

seed.description: Caller-supplied 32-byte seed; committed before launch and never returned by audit.

CodeOffSlotIdentity.description: Closed immutable inference identity for one code-off slot. Every field is pinned at prepare time and hashed into identity_snapshot_hashes and identities_hash; drift at launch or in a terminal receipt fails closed.

CodeOffUsageTotals.description: Exact summed normalized usage over one group of code-off attempts. Cost and turns are null unless every attempt reported them, so a partial sum never reads as the real total.

CodeOffEconomics.description: Sanitized content-addressed aggregate economics for one code-off experiment. Identifiers, hashes, and counts only; never prompts, logs, paths, seeds, or blind label ordering.

CodeOffCompact.description: Strict compact sanitized receipt. Large trees/logs remain content-addressed server-side.

Diagnostic.description: Compact canned diagnostic. It never contains paths, secrets, callback data, provider output, or traces.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path.

create.description: If true, git checkout -b. Not git checkout -B.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path.

clean_untracked.description: If true, remove untracked files and directories with git clean -fd. Gitignored files are retained.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path.

codeoff_experiment_id.description: Optional terminal code-off gate; requires matching final_verification_hash.

writer_job_id.description: Successful writer job whose server-attributed paths are the only model changes committed. The commit fails closed if any attributed path changes after the successful receipt.

add.description: Relative paths to add before commit, or a single path string. Explicit adds are accepted only with validated writer evidence or the complete code-off gate. Writer commits use an isolated index containing only attributed writer paths plus explicit paths; code-off commits use the verified staged index. No .. or absolute paths; add -A is never used.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path.

codeoff_experiment_id.description: Optional terminal code-off gate; requires matching final_verification_hash.

remote.description: Named remote already on the repo. Not a URL. Not --force.

ref.description: HEAD if omitted. No +, no :, no delete, no force.

name.description: scripts.json name only. No client argv.

response_webhook_url.description: https URL from action.wait.webhook pending.resumeUrl. Used when the script is async.

response_webhook_token.description: From action.wait.webhook pending.resumeToken. Sent as X-Rewst-Token on the callback.

expected_head.description: Compared with a fresh server-side PR head

writer_job_id.description: Optional successful agent/session job for the after-fix route

compact.description: Short test/script failure signal for a resume prompt. 'ok' when the recipe passed. Never the full log.

recovery_version.description: Explicit later-invocation recovery marker. Omit it and every recovery evidence field for an ordinary continuation; otherwise the exact version and all four prior route/receipt objects are required.

kick_url.description: https Rewst webhook to start the next slice. Omitted: return frontier only.

fresh_primary_receipt.description: For remote provider failures only: a distinct successful normal-primary job created no earlier than the prior fallback finished.

ProviderRecoveryEvidence.description: Compact route/job identities only. No paths, callbacks, secrets, raw provider output, or traces.

model.description: Explicit model paired with launcher/provider. Native effort follows the validated effective profile.

test.description: tests.json name. Omitted or empty: skip.

auto_merge.description: Off unless this run was started with auto-merge

run_id.description: Merge is only reachable from inside a run

test.description: Must equal the persisted evidence job recipe

evidence_job_id.description: Persisted final pr_merge named-test job; receipts/booleans are not accepted

codeoff_experiment_id.description: Optional issue-67 gate context; paired only and never substitutes for test evidence

merge_method.description: Not named `method`: the connector reads that as the HTTP verb.

kick_url.description: https Rewst webhook for the next attempt

kick_request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical kick request minus run_control and kick_token; the reservation descriptor's exact_request_body_sha256 for the continue leg.

PrContinueRunControl.description: Closed run-control continuity forwarded verbatim to the kicked run as CTX.INPUT.run_control; authorization_id must be rca1-<sha256 of the JSON-quoted run_control_id>-<attempt hex>, exactly as graphwing-run-control-state names it, and launch_descriptor_sha256 is the reservation's persisted descriptor hash, carried from the reserving run because the reconcile graph verifies it against durable state

RunControlSettleRequest.description: Run N+1 settlement of the reservation named by CTX.INPUT.run_control from its own live wait webhook body.

receipt.description: The exact terminal agent receipt delivered to the wait webhook; only a receipt this daemon sealed is usage.

RunControlSettledReceipt.description: The closed receipt graphwing-run-control-reconcile accepts as kind terminal_receipt, in the exact key order its canonical hash expects.

RouteExecutionProfile.description: Closed server-verifiable attribution to one versioned writer or reviewer selection. Runtime reconstructs the exact role/profile from the route catalog and requires request equality.

effort.description: Closed launcher-neutral request. Grok 4.6 supports default→high plus low, medium, and high; max fails closed.

route_execution_profile.description: Optional exact routed-review evidence. Without it, effort provenance is explicit or launcher_default.
Present exactly when effort_source is route.

all_green.description: ghPrChecks: no fail and no pending

remote_state.description: ghPrView remote-only readiness; ready still lacks named-test evidence

remote_ready.description: Remote state only, never a merge-safety attestation

AgentRunRequest.description: The root object avoids combinators unsupported by Rewst custom-integration imports. The endpoint enforces prompt/code-off workspace exclusivity and exact mode-specific identity tuples.

effort.description: Launcher-neutral requested effort. Phase 2 accepts only values proven and propagated by the selected native launcher/model adapter; other known values return unsupported_effort.

route_execution_profile.description: Required to claim route provenance. A routed resume repeats the exact profile pinned in session_identity.

run_control.description: Closed continuity of the reservation this writer runs under, forwarded verbatim from CTX.INPUT.run_control. The daemon pins the job to that reservation at launch (409 reservation_already_launched, reservation_already_settled, run_control_mismatch, continuation_kick_failed) so settlement and authority loss can name the job.

codeoff_workspace.description: Opaque server-resolved workspace; caller paths and prompt overrides are rejected.

resume_job_id.description: Required with native session_identity resume. Must reference a prior completed successful Graphwing job from the same launcher whose receipt session_identity exactly matches.

cwd.description: Allowlisted repo short name, not a filesystem path. Omit for the server policy default.

response_webhook_url.description: https URL from action.wait.webhook pending.resumeUrl. POSTed the bounded receipt when the job finishes.

response_webhook_token.description: From action.wait.webhook pending.resumeToken. Sent as X-Rewst-Token on the callback. Default wait-webhook auth is token.

BranchName.description: Graphwing Phase 1 safe ASCII branch subset, not every Git-valid ref. Slash-separated names are allowed; unsupported punctuation and Unicode, Git-forbidden forms, dot components, and case-insensitive .lock components are rejected.

route_execution_profile.description: Present exactly for route-attributed identities and immutable across resume.

launcher_version.description: Path-free SHA-256 fingerprint of the resolved launcher executable, or missing for an availability-failure job.

repo.description: Validated path-free allowlist short name, including internal code-off identities.

starting_head.description: Validated full lowercase Git object ID (SHA-1 or SHA-256 object format).

native_session_id.description: Parsed from launcher-owned structured output: Codex thread.started.thread_id, Claude result.session_id, or Grok ACP session/new result.sessionId. Required non-null for success and resume.

model.description: Exact requested model retained after launcher-native execution provenance checks; Codex and Claude prove the executed model.

summary.description: Canned allowlisted text derived only from diagnostic.code; never launcher output.

failure_class.description: Closed launcher outcome class. Only provider_availability may be failover eligible.

failure_code.description: Stable machine code within failure_class; none on success.

failover_eligible.description: True only for structured or deterministic provider availability failures.

usage.description: Closed numeric native aggregate; never raw provider events or inferred list-price cost.

DiagnosticError.description: stack, port, or initial writer error with a compact diagnostic
